designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1983 to conserve the endangered northern red-bellied cooter and other native wildlife in Plymouth, Massachusetts.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Massasoit National Wildlife Refuge, established in 1983, is one of eight national wildlife refuges that comprise the Eastern Massachusetts National Wildlife Refuge Complex.
